item.title: Concrete barrier lane blocked, 8th August
item.description:
During late afternoon rush hour when schools are open, as the left lane Advent Way exit has been barrier blocked for more than 2 years, it becomes very dangerous to navigate this roundabout during rush hour as vehicles coming from the A406 always block this roundabout and there are only two lanes but you frequently see vehicles make 3-4 lanes trying to force their way as this section is a wide road. It gets a lot worse during winter when it is dark as it’s impossible to know if someone is giving you way to enter the blocked roundabout. It is a dangerous and stressful roundabout to navigate. There have been accidents just from low speed dents and a lot of road rage incidents. Please remove the barrier and maybe introduce more traffic lights with yellow box to make this safer and better to navigate. Thank you

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Angel Road, Edmonton
Report on FixMyStreet
